title: How to Cancel The Athletic — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel The Athletic subscription in 2 minutes. Stop the monthly charge. Now owned by NYT — here's the current cancellation process.
intro: The Athletic (owned by the New York Times) can be canceled online through your account settings. Unlike NYT proper, The Athletic doesn't require phone calls.

steps.title: Go to your Athletic account
steps.text: Visit theathletic.com/account and sign in. Navigate to your subscription details.

steps.title: Click "Cancel Subscription"
steps.text: Find the cancellation option in your account settings and click it. The Athletic will show your access end date.

steps.title: Decline any retention offers
steps.text: They may offer a discounted rate. Click through if you want to fully cancel.
steps.tip: The Athletic frequently offers $1-2/month comeback deals. If you can wait, cancel and take the offer when it arrives by email.

steps.title: Confirm cancellation
steps.text: Confirm your choice. Access continues until the end of your billing period.

warnings: If subscribed through Apple App Store or Google Play, cancel through their subscription settings.
If you got The Athletic through a NY Times bundle, you may need to manage it through NYT account settings.
Your saved articles and preferences are preserved if you re-subscribe.

faqs.q: Is The Athletic free with NY Times subscription?
faqs.a: Some NYT All Access plans include The Athletic. Check your NYT account benefits before paying for a separate Athletic subscription.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund from The Athletic?
faqs.a: Contact The Athletic support for refund requests. They may offer prorated refunds for annual plans. Apple/Google subscriptions must go through those platforms.

faqs.q: What happens after I cancel The Athletic?
faqs.a: You lose access to all articles and podcasts when your billing period ends. No free tier is available.

refund.details: Contact The Athletic support for refund requests. Annual plans may be eligible for prorated refunds within a reasonable timeframe.

retentionTactics: The Athletic offers significant discounts ($1-2/month for 6-12 months).
They send aggressive re-subscription emails after canceling with deals.
